info.title: Meta Service
info.description: Wraps the Meta (Facebook) Graph API v22.0 for ad account management, performance reporting, and organic posting.

AdCopy.description: Text only. No image is supplied and none is generated: Meta renders the destination page's own link preview.

customEventType.description: Required when goal is OFFSITE_CONVERSIONS, e.g. PURCHASE, LEAD, ADD_TO_CART, COMPLETE_REGISTRATION.

OptimizationGoal.description: What the ad set optimises delivery for. Per campaign, and changeable afterwards: the right event moves one step deeper down the funnel as volume accrues.
